• Hard Goods (bee houses, accessories) ship according to the shipping method selected at checkout (such as USPS Ground).

What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If your tracking number is pending or hasn't updated, please wait three days from when it was shipped, as delayed packages often arrive or update during that window. (For bee shipments, please reach out the day after the expected due date).
If it still hasn't updated after that time, please get in touch with us and we will issue a replacement for your order.
